# Pull request

## What does this change?

<!-- A short description. Link any related issue. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New catalog resource(s)
- [ ] New or updated learning path
- [ ] Site / UI change
- [ ] Tooling, tests, or docs
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run catalog:validate` passes with no errors
- [ ] `npm run catalog:generate` was run and `README.md` / `public/api/catalog.json` are committed
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test -- --run` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds

### For new resources

- [ ] The `sourceUrl` is HTTPS and free of tracking parameters
- [ ] The summary is written in my own words (not copied from the source)
- [ ] `free` and `openSource` are accurate; paid content is not labelled free
- [ ] I agree to license my original summary under CC BY 4.0

<!-- Thanks for contributing! -->
